dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: I'm just taking a look around the market. Don't forget to stop by the Wanwen Bookhouse if you have time.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Although, the store is full of old books that won't sell... I'm half inclined to turn them into scrap paper and donate them as Mingxiao Lantern supplies.
